# Oka — LLM / agent orientation

> Declarative, compositional build system for Flutter Android (no Gradle default path).
> One typed Dart file (`tool/oka_pipeline.dart`) composes pipelines and targets.

## Start here (agents)

- AGENTS.md — router map, non-negotiables, command index
- docs/FAQ.md — newcomer questions (grounded in repo)
- docs/guides/build_and_config.mdx — how to run, build, configure
- docs/guides/design_faq.mdx — why decisions were made
- docs/start_here/quick_recipes.mdx — copy-paste command loops

## Invariants (do not violate)

- Default build success must never use `flutter build apk` or Gradle (ADR-0001).
- Only one Android build path (no cargo-apk hybrid; ADR-0009).
- Docs link to code; they do not paraphrase implementation as SSOT.

## Primary CLI (packages/oka/bin/oka.dart)

init, explain, why, build, compare, debug, run, dev, doctor, get, clean, cache,
launch, live, ship, processes, stop, session-state, supervisor, artifacts

## Repository layout

- packages/oka — CLI
- packages/oka_core — contracts (pipeline, artifacts)
- packages/oka_android — Android pipeline
- packages/oka_play, oka_huawei, oka_rustore, oka_web — distribution targets
- example/ — full reference app; examples/ — learning ladder

## Contributor gates

just install && just lint && just test && just check-contracts

## Human docs site

https://docs.page/arenukvern/oka
